verdict.rationale: The evidence shows ranking control beyond pure keyword matching: hybrid search merges full-text and vector rankings via RRF, and the homepage mentions reranking. Nothing in the pack shows ranking on business signals such as popularity, recency or margin, or user-defined ranking rules. Missing for 10: documented business-signal boosting (popularity/recency/margin), custom scoring or ranking-rule mechanisms, and independent or hands-on corroboration of relevance tuning.
